summary: Startup Wise Guys Founders Club 21 accepts applications until November 2, 2026. The year is explicit on the official Spain program listing and supported by the August 18, 2026 cohort announcement. This is a three-month online B2B founder program with participant fees; investment is conditional.

proposed_event.name: Startup Wise Guys — Founders Club 21
proposed_event.description: Three-month online program for individuals and early B2B teams to find cofounders, validate a problem and develop an MVP. Participation is paid; investment opportunities are conditional.

dates.date_range_text: Applications for Cohort 21 close November 2, 2026, with rolling selection and possible earlier closure. Exact cutoff time and program dates are unpublished.

sources.title: The Founders Club
sources.supports: Founders Club 21, November 2 cutoff, rolling selection, three-month online format, individual/team/developer participation fees and conditional investment.

sources.title: Startup Wise Guys — Spain programs
sources.supports: Explicit November 2nd, 2026 application deadline displayed immediately above The Founders Club.

sources.title: Founders Club 19 graduates; Cohort 21 applications
sources.supports: Article dated August 18, 2026 states that Cohort 21 applications are open, reviewed on a rolling basis, and due before November 2.

notes: Fees: €1,000+VAT for individuals, €1,500+VAT for teams, and €500+VAT for CTOs/developers. The page separately advertises conditional investment up to €100K with a €35K program cost and possible follow-on investment; these are not guaranteed grants.
Selection is first come, first served and scouting may close early. The exact cutoff time, timezone and cohort start date are not published.
Founders Club is distinct from the Flagship Accelerator and other Startup Wise Guys programs.
